what: When opening, a blueprint layer is drawn for each element in the panel — a dashed box, corner brackets, a dimension label ‹name · width×height›, plus horizontal guide lines through the top and bottom edges of the box and a vertical guide line through the right edge. Horizontal lines 1s expo.inOut (.04 stagger), vertical lines after .1s (.06 stagger), box .3s starting at .35s, labels starting at .4s with a .07 stagger, the symbol running ahead, typed out over .5s. When clearing (fx:clear or after hold seconds) label .4s → box .6s → lines fold to the opposite end over .9s and the layer is removed

options.delay: Draw start delay (seconds), default 0 — the original is 1.45s after the curtain on a first visit, .1s on return
options.hold: Time from drawing to clearing (seconds, counted from delay), default 4.2 · with event it stays until fx:clear is fired on the panel
options.[data-fx-part=spec]: Elements to put the box on (multiple) — label name comes from data-spec (tag name if absent)
